_meta.description: Per-file provenance vs HestiaCP. A file with no upstream_path is HestiaRE-native. Recompute is a manual, occasional job (when we reimplement against upstream or re-measure a snapshot); numbers are a snapshot at each file's upstream_ref + measured_at, not live. HestiaRE does not cherry-pick: every adoption is a reimplementation, compared per function against the upstream diff, so these numbers are orientation for that comparison - not a merge plan.
_meta.divergence_method: churn = (added+removed)/(upstream_lines+our_lines)*100, from a line diff between the two blobs. RAW: includes the mechanical v-*->h-* rename + path churn (install/->share/, CONF_DIR, func/->include/), so it OVERSTATES semantic divergence. Triage, not truth. BINARY files are measured by byte identity instead (pct 0 or 100, method "bytes"): a line diff on a binary reports nothing at all - git numstat prints "-" - which silently read as 0% churn and typed a differing font or image as verbatim.

source_type_values.verbatim: Upstream file we track closely (churn <=3%). Mechanical: reseeded from the measured pct on every recompute, never set by hand.
source_type_values.derived: Reimplemented or diverged from upstream on purpose (churn >3%). Mechanical: reseeded from the measured pct on every recompute, never set by hand.
source_type_values.eigenbau: HestiaRE-native: no upstream counterpart. The one curated value - a recompute never changes it. An 'inspired by' pointer belongs in the note, not in upstream_path.

_meta.folder_note: Upstream calls this directory func/; HestiaRE renamed it to include/ because it holds sourced libraries, not only functions. The upstream_path fields below therefore all read func/*, and the rename itself is part of the raw churn.

upstream_files_not_adopted.func/remote.sh: REST API is a permanent ground-rule exclusion - nothing to port.
upstream_files_not_adopted.func/upgrade.sh: No update/migration paths before v1 (no production instances), so there is no upgrade library to carry.
upstream_files_not_adopted.func/internal/dns_record_validator.php: No bundled DNS server (bind9 is a ground-rule exclusion), so no DNS record validation.

aggregate.weighted_pct_note: text files only - binary entries are byte-compared, not line-counted

_meta.recompute_rule: Reseed before every minor release: recompute against the current upstream/hestiacp snapshot and let source_type follow the fresh pct. verbatim/derived is a bucketing of the measured number, so it goes stale exactly when the number does - it drifted 80 entries out of step once (#551). eigenbau is the one curated value and a recompute never touches it. Byte-compared entries carry no pct at all - there is no percentage to have: the reseed reads their `identical` flag, text entries their pct.

files.note: Backup format is bidirectionally compatible with HestiaCP forever, so this stays close to upstream on purpose.
Per-user Docker (#389); upstream has no counterpart.
No DNS half (bind9 excluded); web/mail template handling reworked for the Caddy/nginx/apache model.
Jail rendering as a modular addon (#525).
Effectively eigenbau: upstream ships 25 lines, this is the 685-line nftables renderer (#495). Kept mapped rather than relabelled so the upstream path stays findable.
Installer helpers (hestia_apt, load_os_profile, seed_hestia_etc); the whole installer was rebuilt from scratch, no upstream path.
Customer PHP CPU cap: slice, drop-ins and the one percent parser (#212).
Carries the HestiaRE input hardening (single-eval object parser, source_conf, validator char classes) and the BIN/SBIN/CONF_DIR anchors.
Reserved-port set for the panel port, derived from the shipped listener declarations (#730).
Project quota: arming, enforcement probe and project-id assignment (#211).

Own dependency-free DOMDocument allow-list sanitizer (#471); upstream's counterpart is a 19-line wrapper around a bundled library we rejected. Lived in func/internal/ until the subdirectory was dissolved.
Key registry + repair model reworked (#654: an empty value no longer counts as present).
Web model (nginx / both / apache-only) keyset and switch (#120).
Manifest-driven install wizard; upstream has no interactive wizard.
